settings.title: Settings
settings.backendDescription: Choose the hardware platform that runs the model.

cpu.label: CPU
cpu.description: Works, but slow; not recommended for large models.

settings.promptDescription: Tells the model to use specific spellings or styles. Not fully reliable, but it helps with proper names and technical terms.
settings.promptPlaceholder: E.g.: Biology lecture about the mitochondria, the ribosome and DNA.
settings.promptTooLong: Whisper only uses the last ~224 tokens; the rest is ignored.
settings.maxLenDescription: Sets the maximum length of each segment in characters. Enter 0 for no limit.
settings.suppressNstDescription: Avoids text that is not spoken in the audio, e.g. (dramatic music), although it may slow down processing.
settings.vadDescription: Whisper only transcribes the parts with speech: avoids made-up sentences during silence, music or background noise. Uses a 1 MB model that is downloaded once.
settings.vadFailed: Could not download the voice filter. Transcription runs without it; check your connection and turn the switch on again.
settings.normalizeDescription: If the file has a low volume, it is normalized before transcribing to improve the transcription quality.
settings.threadsDescription: Threads used by the transcription engine. By default, half of the cores ({{default}} of {{total}}).
settings.showCaptionsDescription: Turns the subtitles over the video on or off.
settings.videoHeightDescription: Sets the height of the video panel in pixels (180–600).
settings.uiLanguageDescription: Choose the language of the app.
settings.previewCacheDescription: H.264 copies of videos that cannot be played directly. It takes up {{size}}.
settings.thirdPartyIntro: {{app}} uses the following open-source components. Thanks to their authors.
settings.recordShortcutDescription: Works even with the app in the background. Hold it to record until you let go; press it twice in a row (e.g. Ctrl+Win, Win) to record hands-free until you press it again or stop it from the dock.
settings.recordShortcutFailed: Windows did not allow the shortcut. Try another combination or restart the app.

recordShortcutErrors.noModifier: The shortcut needs at least Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
recordShortcutErrors.needsTwoModifiers: Without another key, the shortcut needs two modifiers (e.g. Ctrl + Win).
recordShortcutErrors.unknownKey: That key can’t be used: pick a letter, a number, F1–F24 or Space.
recordShortcutErrors.twoKeys: Use a single key besides the modifiers.

settings.suggestMeetingsDescription: When a call starts in Teams, Zoom, Webex, Slack, Discord or Skype, the dock asks whether to record it. It never records without your confirmation.
settings.detectSpeakersDescription: While recording, each sentence is tagged with who says it (You, Person 1, Person 2…). Click a tag to give it a name. Uses a 28 MB voice model that is downloaded once.
settings.detectSpeakersFailed: The voice model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and turn the switch on again.
settings.dockPositionDescription: Where the dock hides: at the top or bottom of the screen, at a corner or in the middle.
